dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal conjecture on the generality of the probabilistic minor strategy
dossier_meta.statement_text: The strategy introduced in this paper, or minor modifications of it, could provide a useful tool for finding clique minors in graphs under other structural restrictions as well.
dossier_meta.context_text: After showing that the same randomised star-contraction strategy yields both Theorem 1 (for $K_s$-free graphs with bounded independence number) and a short proof of the Kühn–Osthus result for $K_{s,t}$-free graphs, the authors note that the approach performs well in two quite different structural settings.
